Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: if the new and old iPhones have different dimensions, you'll need to buy a new case.

Users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro will almost inevitably need to purchase a new case—but two accessory makers have different views on this, and one of them has made an even bolder prediction...

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, noting that the product is already on sale at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging is labelled in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself was not entirely convinced, adding that "it's too early to draw conclusions just yet." However, Matt Ronge, founder of Astropad, which focuses on iPhone anti-glare screen protectors, said his suppliers had told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker pointed out that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The report did not mention the smaller Pro model, but iPhone supply chain sources indicated that the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimetres thicker than the previous generation.

This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers share the same view—some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimension information ahead of time so that third-party cases can launch alongside the new iPhone. On the other hand, accessory makers have sometimes placed production orders purely based on rumours, which are sometimes inaccurate. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
